description: This file defines API routes for user management in a FastAPI application, including user CRUD operations, registration, profile updates, password changes, and deletion.

methods.name: read_users
methods.description: Retrieve a list of users with pagination, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: create_user
methods.description: Create a new user and send a notification email if enabled.

methods.name: update_user_me
methods.description: Update the current user's profile information.

methods.name: update_password_me
methods.description: Update the current user's password after verification.

methods.name: register_user
methods.description: Register a new user without authentication.

methods.name: read_user_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve a user by their UUID, with privilege checks.

methods.name: update_user
methods.description: Update a user's details, accessible only to superusers.

methods.name: delete_user
methods.description: Delete a user and associated items, accessible only to superusers.
